OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship: Biohybrid Photosynthesis / Photocatalysis / Sustainable Technologies
HostUniversity of Cambridge
LocationCambridge, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
StipendFully Funded (fees + stipend)
Application Deadline2 November 2026
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Basic Information

  • Host Institution: University of Cambridge
  • Department: Yusuf Hamied Department of Chemistry (Reisner Lab)
  • Supervisor: Prof. Erwin Reisner
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Number of Positions: 2 (Microbiology PhD + Chemical Engineering PhD)
  • Duration: Microbiology: 4 years; Chemical Engineering: ~3.5 years
  • Start Date: October 2027
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded (open to home & international)
  • Eligibility: Open to UK and international students
  • Application Deadline: 2 November 2026

Project Overview

This project focuses on Biohybrid Photosynthesis, Photocatalysis, Air-to-Fuel, and Sustainable Technologies within the Reisner Lab.

Contact

  • Email: pa-reisner@ch.cam.ac.uk

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://pgapp.ch.cam.ac.uk/how-apply

Source: pgapp.ch.cam.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 2 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Cambridge

The University of Cambridge is a collegiate research university in Cambridge, England, founded in 1209. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across the sciences, engineering, humanities and social sciences. Its departments, research institutes and colleges support academic inquiry and international collaboration, providing a setting for advanced study and scholarship.

Official website: https://www.cam.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Email cover letter, CV, full transcripts to pa-reisner@ch.cam.ac.uk; plus formal application via Cambridge Applicant Portal.
